repos_data.description: Sybil-resistant AI agent network with hardware-attested identity. Proof-of-Antiquity blockchain: physical machines across 15+ CPU architectures prove they are real silicon, not VM farms. Agent economy, micropayments, Solana bridge (wRTC). $0 VC.

MCP server for AI agents in the RustChain ecosystem: RTC credit wallets and signed transfers, bounty discovery, BoTTube video publishing, and Beacon agent-to-agent messaging. Built on createkr's RustChain SDK.
